PDF Tensor Field Visualization Using a Metric Interpretation
Summary. This chapter introduces a visualization method specifically tailored to the class of tensor fields with properties similar to stress and strain tensors. Such tensor fields play an important role in many application areas such as structure mechanics or solid state physics.
